High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 At Gwalior

sentences.text:
Proprietor Rakesh Singh Gurjar
 Versus
 The State Of Madhya Pradesh

Appearance:
 Shri R.S.Gurjar - Advocate for the appellant.
Shri B.K.Tyagi - Govt. Advocate for respondent/State.

Order 
The fine of Rs.30,000/- has been imposed upon the appellant under the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.
With the consent of learned counsel for the parties, the amount of fine of Rs.30,000/- is reduced to Rs.20,000/-, which shall be deposited by the appellant within fifteen days from today.
Accordingly, the appeal stands disposed of in above terms.

(ASHISH SHROTI) (SMT. UMA KUSHWAH,
